(PC §§ 1301.3.2, 608.8.1)

For the wording, PC § 608.8.1 specifies: “Nonpotable water is utilized for (application name). CAUTION: NONPOTABLE WATER – DO NOT DRINK.” PC § 1301.3.2 gives the corresponding text as “Nonpotable water is utilized for. CAUTION: NONPOTABLE WATER – DO NOT DRINK.” It also requires the pictograph shown in Figure 1301.3; § 608.8.1 requires the pictograph shown in Figure 608.8.1. Use corrosion-resistant, waterproof material if the message is on a tag or sign. (PC §§ 1301.3.2, 608.8.1)

These outlet-sign rules do not replace the separate identification requirements for nonpotable piping, if applicable. (PC §§ 608.8, 608.8.2)
